author: Void
name: VoidCogs
description: A Red Discord Bot cog repository containing Void, a role-isolation moderation tool that hides every channel from a punished member for a set duration and logs through Red's modlog.
install_msg: Thanks for adding VoidCogs. Install the Void cog with `[p]cog install <repo> void` then `[p]load void`. Run `[p]voidset setup` in each server after loading.
